formulation: Prism splits a composite into named components
treatment: Typed facet projection separates admitted records by declared metadata; no optical interception is implemented.

formulation: NSA PRISM is literal fiber-optic rainbow separation
treatment: E1 distinguishes provider/downstream PRISM from backbone/upstream acquisition; no all-senses collection claim follows.

formulation: A Pride flag is a harvesting trap
treatment: No acquisition evidence or causal demonstration is supplied. The rainbow is a chosen interface palette; displaying it is not consent or proof of any personal trait.

formulation: A hash makes identity tamper-proof and immutable
treatment: A digest detects byte differences against a trusted reference. It does not authenticate a person, authorize access or make an assertion true.

formulation: Every scraped bit belongs in the definition DAG
treatment: The fixed operator registry and variable event/object records are distinct. Reference links are not observations of reality.

formulation: The entire life fits into one exact compressed word
treatment: An injective serialization retains supplied finite data; it cannot force arbitrary history into the fixed Gambit state length or a small color token.

formulation: Equal Hamming weight means identical behavior
treatment: 0011 and 1100 both have Hamming weight two and differ in their active positions. A count neither identifies a person nor establishes behavior.
XOR by 0011 flips two bits and preserves parity. Parity neither identifies which bit changed nor authenticates its source.

formulation: A latch retains every anomaly forever
treatment: Latch sequences 0→0→0 and 0→1→0 have the same endpoint and event XOR. Ordered history requires a separate record.
C15 is one intervention witness under a specified seed, not a guarantee about arbitrary people or signals.

formulation: Gaze proves sexuality, religion or hidden intention
treatment: Gaze remains a labelled measurement only. No protected-trait or hidden-intention classifier is supplied or implemented.

formulation: Generated Dutch atlas groups all humanity
treatment: The atlas concerns the bounded 0–99 number profile; it supplies no population dataset or behavioral equivalence relation.

formulation: Rainbowing makes artificial islands evidence of surveillance
treatment: No geographical or surveillance evidence is supplied. The corpus bit-islands are geometric encoding locations.

formulation: Divide et impera as global social control
treatment: Retained as a governance concern. The implementation partitions one holder’s data domains, not populations for manipulation.

formulation: All individual data in a digital passport
treatment: All means the admitted, inventoried, permissioned scope at a timestamp. Missing and unavailable sources remain explicit.
